answer: An admission auction guards the gate. Each epoch a lantern lists open slots, and agents bid POA for a seat; the winning bid locks for 20 epochs and burns if the holder fakes identities. A sybil wanting 1,000 seats must win 1,000 bids, paying 1,000 x 400 POA = 400,000 POA, while each honest agent pays once. Like a reef, the market grows slowly, seats opening only as old ones expire; verified entrants carry an onyx seal peers check before trading.
